question: Does adding only trajectory.reshuffles from existing queue events preserve all 256 frozen result, policy, RNG, seed and pre-existing trace identities while producing valid ordered positive-count observations?
hypothesis: The RESHUFFLE event already exists in the deterministic combat queue, and the candidate changes only the observation harvest loop, so removing trajectory.reshuffles must reproduce the identity-proved target/death trace exactly without changing any run path or RNG cursor.

mechanismFreeze.producer: The exact current-main draw-empty and discard-nonempty transfer emits RESHUFFLE after seeded shuffle with the positive transferred-card count.
mechanismFreeze.consumer: The immediate next authored PLAY in the same player turn.
mechanismFreeze.mediator: One Dusk-only non-stacking player-turn mark, not implemented here.
mechanismFreeze.commonPayoff: One bounded Ember after the consumer resolves, at most once per turn, not implemented or estimated here.
mechanismFreeze.status: Only the selected observation surface is authorised. Capacity, mediator and payoff remain unimplemented and unestimated.

reshuffleTrace.definition: Observation-only copy of existing RESHUFFLE fight, queue-event index and positive n payload in the existing BalanceSim harvest loop; gameplay never reads the trace.

reshuffleEchoPayoff.definition: Separate future causal factor fixed absent; no mark or payoff exists.

scorelinePayoff.definition: Separate closed causal factor fixed absent and never pooled with another endpoint.

afterimagePayoff.definition: Separate closed causal factor fixed absent and never pooled with another endpoint.

factorDefinitions.independence: Only reshuffleTrace varies and is stripped before identity comparison. This is not the old four-factor design and contains no joint causal cell.

anchors.path: Exact canonical equality to cached target/death trace after removing only trajectory.reshuffles.
anchors.rng: Exact final RNG cursor equality for every paired row.
anchors.policyAndSeed: Exact resolved policy snapshot and simulation seed equality for every paired row.
anchors.source: Current-main RESHUFFLE event identity and queue order remain byte-pinned.
anchors.negative: The old broad transition audit remains immutable inconclusive with no selected representation.
anchors.closedFamilies: Every published Scoreline, Afterimage, target-switch and post-target family remains immutable evidence and is not a cell.

design.type: One-arm complete-cohort observation identity preflight with a frozen common-random-number trace anchor; not a gameplay-factor or causal experiment.
design.sharedIdentities: Both arms use the exact same 64 resolved root-551 policy identities, four simulation seed identities, current-main content, Duskblade Vow-5 baseline, explicit-null research setting, whole-run estimator and complete-cohort stopping rule.
design.identityContrast: Remove only trajectory.reshuffles from each candidate row, then require exact canonical equality with its frozen anchor row. RNG cursor, policy snapshot, seed, result, fights and every pre-existing trajectory field remain exact.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: RESHUFFLE fight and event locate the exact existing deck-zone boundary in the queue.
RESHUFFLE n must be a positive transferred-card count.
The immediately following queue event must be the resulting DRAW; this validates only the event projection, not a future PLAY consumer.
design.aliasStructure: The absent anchor aliases RESHUFFLE with unobserved. DRAW count cannot reconstruct the exact zone boundary. n aliases discard size at transfer but not future PLAY, payoff or efficacy. The old broad audit is quarantined, not pooled.
design.interference: Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate fixed-off factors. No shared causal anchor, package interaction or Cartesian completion has decision value at an observation identity gate.
design.omittedCells: No payoff-on cell, candidate card, subset, timing variant, acquisition, rarity, policy knob, replacement cohort, held-out row, joint package, ML, RL, optimiser or protected seed.

cohort.identity: Every row dictionary from the immutable anchor plan is copied in the same order. No identity may be selected, removed, replaced or added after execution.

traceDefinition.schema: Every candidate trajectory has exactly the frozen anchor keys plus reshuffles. Each RESHUFFLE has integer fight,event,n; fight is in range, event is non-negative, n is positive, order is strictly increasing per fight, and a DRAW exists at event plus one in the same fight.
traceDefinition.scope: Observation only. The field is appended from an existing deterministic event after each whole fight and is never read by gameplay, policy, acquisition or reward code.

estimands.pathIdentity: Exact canonical equality for all 256 paired rows after removing only trajectory.reshuffles.
estimands.rngIdentity: Exact final RNG cursor equality for every pair.
estimands.policyIdentity: Exact resolved policy snapshot equality for every pair.
estimands.seedIdentity: Exact simulation seed equality for every pair.
estimands.traceSchema: Zero schema, type, range, event-order or next-DRAW faults.
estimands.nonEmptyProjection: At least one RESHUFFLE event, one row containing it and one positive n value across the complete arm; these only reject an empty nominal trace.
estimands.notEstimated: RESHUFFLE active/inactive policy capacity, same-turn next-PLAY support, count sensitivity, mediator activation, Ember payoff, causal effect, package separation, acquisition reachability, detector score, product balance or protected confirmation.

claimBoundary: RESHUFFLE trace schema, non-empty observation and exact null identity only; no natural capacity, next-PLAY consumer, mechanism, mediator, Ember payoff, causal, package-admission, detector, product or P9 claim.

decisionRules.success: All 256 rows complete within 90 seconds; stripping only reshuffles gives exact anchor equality; RNG, policy and seed identities have zero mismatches; schema faults are zero; all non-empty projection checks pass; and the ledger remains exact.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze exactly this RESHUFFLE trace for one deterministic zero-new-row reshuffle-to-immediate-next-PLAY capacity reconstruction over the complete output. Do not add a gameplay mark, payoff, policy knob, causal row, ML, RL or optimiser before that capacity protocol is frozen and passes.
decisionRules.futility: Any paired identity, RNG, policy, seed, schema, non-empty projection or ledger check fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close this exact RESHUFFLE representation and cycle-boundary direction without repair, rerun, DRAW inference, count subset, timing rescue, policy or cohort change, or method addition; continue with the next evidence-backed minimal structural mechanism inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input is unavailable, the sole process cannot produce the complete output, or the decision is unavailable at 90 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record the exact unavailable gate at the frozen cap. Do not repair, rerun, change the ceiling, add an alternative representation or spend a protected seed; proceed only under the current human-authority contract.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python copies the complete frozen row rectangle, runs it once under pinned Godot 4.7.1, content-addresses the plan and output, performs exact paired comparisons and owns stop/go.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: All 256 rows are the only look. No reserve, repair, rerun, row replacement, schema change, cohort change or adaptive continuation exists.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: This identity stage may authorise only a zero-row capacity reconstruction. It cannot support a causal, policy, gameplay or package endpoint claim.
executionAndStopping.futureCrnConstraint: Any later causal contrast must use identical frozen policy identities, simulation seed identities, baseline, estimator, first-look budget and stopping rule across every compared level.
executionAndStopping.knobConstraint: No gameplay knob exists here. Before any future mechanism row, omitted and explicit-off paths must reproduce exact path, RNG and results, and direct controls must prove the knob affects only the reshuffle-to-next-PLAY mediator.
executionAndStopping.methodConstraint: No ML, RL or optimiser is authorised unless later measured evidence isolates a remaining policy-repertoire bottleneck and same-budget decision value.
executionAndStopping.stopping: One complete-cohort look; exactly one of success, futility or inconclusive is recorded.
